representative_scale.selection: Every paired-apo PINDER-S test complex in release 2024-02; no scale search or doubling.
representative_scale.candidate_count_basis: Prospective fixed intake design choice, not claimed published baseline configuration.
representative_scale.AAV_challenge: Separate three-structure redocking challenge; report separately, never pooled into 93-case score.

inputs.required: Release index/metadata, 93 paired apo receptor-ligand inputs, experimental native dimers, FRODOCK software and configuration.
inputs.format: Published PINDER pre-rotated and translated monomer PDB files; configuration JSON/YAML and method setup CSV.
inputs.configuration_status: Not execution-ready: software download, exact IDs, software pin and seed schedule unresolved.

outputs.scoring_interface: pinder_eval --eval_dir eval_dir; per-decoy DockQ, iRMS, LRMS and Fnat plus method summaries.
reports: Top-1 acceptable fraction and median DockQ
Best-of-100 acceptable fraction and median DockQ, reported separately
Runtime, throughput, cost and time to acceptable pose
outputs.missing_predictions: Apply published missing-system penalties; never silently drop failed cases.

timing_scope.setup: Report installation and input staging separately.
timing_scope.method_run: Time complete docking including grids, search, clustering and writing fixed 100 poses for each case.
timing_scope.evaluate: Time scoring separately; include all candidates when reporting end-to-end cost.
timing_scope.time_to_acceptable: Requires time-stamped candidate availability and retrospective native scoring; not inferable from final ranked output alone.

budget_feasibility.reason: No workloads run. Cannot establish that 93-case docking finishes within default method_run=1200 seconds or evaluation=2400 seconds. No invented runtime estimate or budget override.
